newsitem.title: UK: GROBBELAAR'S MATCH-RIGGING RETRIAL SET FOR JUNE 4.
newsitem.headline: GROBBELAAR'S MATCH-RIGGING RETRIAL SET FOR JUNE 4.

text.p: The retrial of former Liverpool goalkeeper Bruce Grobbelaar and two other stars of British soccer on match-rigging charges will begin on June 4 this year, a judge ruled on Monday.

Grobbelaar with former Wimbledon goalkeeper Hans Segers, former Aston Villa striker John Fashanu and Malaysian businessman Heng Suan Lim, is charged with attempting to throw football matches in Britain's premier league. Their original trial ended on March 4 after eight weeks when a jury failed to reach a verdict despite two days of deliberations in the southern city of Winchester. The retrial will also be held in Winchester. Grobbelaar and Dutch-born Segers were accused of rigging matches on behalf of an Asian betting syndicate.
Grobbelaar faced a separate charge of accepting money as an inducement to throw matches.
John Fashanu and Malaysian businessman Lim were charged with acting as middlemen in the alleged conspiracy. All four denied the charges.
